description: Search Sentry agent conversations (formerly AI conversations): one summary row per LLM agent conversation with title, cost, tokens, call counts, and previews. For one conversation's transcript, use get_agent_conversation_details.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

end.description: End of the search window; requires start.

environment.description: Environment name, or an array of environments.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

items.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

project.description: Project slug or numeric project ID, or an array of projects.

regionUrl.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

start.description: Start of the search window; requires end and overrides period.

name: search_agent_conversations
title: Search Agent Conversations
